description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of five different models or model configurations on a zero-shot classification task, with the vertical axis representing Accuracy (%) ranging from 40% to 65% in 5% increments and the horizontal axis listing the model names. The models are: RoBERTa w/o Exp. (light gray), ExEnt (light blue), LaSQuE (mean) (orange), LaSQuE (green), and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) (dark gray). The LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) model achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 62%, followed by LaSQuE (mean) at approximately 58%, LaSQuE (green) at approximately 48%, ExEnt at approximately 55%, and RoBERTa w/o Exp. at approximately 46%. The bars are presented in a single group, with each bar's color corresponding to its model as indicated in the legend, and they are arranged in the order listed above from left to right. The chart does not show any sorting of bars by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
